name: Milia Meulendolff
original_name: ミリア・メーレンドルフ
source:
"My dream is to become a millionaire-- With such a once in a lifetime opportunity like this, there's no way I'd miss it!"

- Origin: Nestor
- Birthday: November 21
- Height: 149cm
- Three Size: B87(G)/W60/H85
- Likes: Making money/Grandfather
- Dislikes: Any bad words about grandfather
- Will/Gem: "Treasure Digging Bird's Eye Physiognomy" Dig Dug Citrine

A girl from Nestor, the neighboring country of Delta.
She came to the frontline of the Second Tourmaline Rush as a Garimpeiro (miners who mine ores for a living).
She is always accompanied by her two pet companions(?) Hamihami and Gordon.

[Translated from [url=http://cabbage-soft.com/character/]Official Website[/url]]
